[SWS_CM_90451] Byte order of the length field for extensible structs
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204
⌈
The length field, inserted in front of the serialized extensible struct, shall be encoded
in network byte order (big endian), as specified by [PRS_SOMEIP_00759].
⌋
For the length field of serialization of optional members see [PRS_SOMEIP_00229].
Regarding structure members and serialization examples, refer to [4].
